description: Land Acquisition - Talkota, Sinhapura, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and claimants in various villages. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
